recipes.title: One-Pan Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice
recipes.instructions:
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Sear thighs skin-side down in butter until golden, then set aside.
Soften diced onion and garlic in the same pan.
Stir in rice to toast for 1 minute, then pour in the broth.
Nestle the chicken back on top, cover, and simmer 20 minutes until the rice is tender.
Rest 5 minutes, fluff, and finish with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Weeknight Tomato Basil Pasta
recipes.instructions:
Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente.
Warm olive oil and sliced garlic until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and a pinch of red pepper flakes.
Simmer the sauce 10 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and a splash of pasta water.
Finish off the heat with torn basil and Parmesan.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Honey Garlic Salmon
recipes.instructions:
Heat the oven to 425°F.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, and a squeeze of lemon.
Toss broccoli with olive oil and salt on a sheet pan.
Add the salmon, brush generously with the glaze, and roast 12–15 minutes.
Spoon the pan juices over the top and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Black Bean Quesadillas
recipes.instructions:
Mash the drained black beans with cumin and a pinch of salt.
Spread over half of each tortilla, then top with cheese, diced pepper, and green onion.
Fold and cook in a dry skillet over medium heat until golden and the cheese melts, about 2–3 minutes per side.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats, Three Ways
recipes.instructions:
Stir oats, milk, yogurt, chia, maple syrup, and vanilla in a jar.
Seal and refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours).
In the morning, loosen with a splash of milk.
Top one of three ways: berries + almonds, banana + peanut butter, or apple + cinnamon.
